catalog.description: The catalog field specifies the Knackly catalog to which the record belongs.

record_id.description: The record_id field uniquely identifies the record within its catalog.

id.description: The id field uniquely identifies the record. This is the same as the record_id field at the top level.

label.description: The label field provides a human-readable name for the record.

detail.description: The detail field provides additional information about the record.

lastModified.description: The lastModified field indicates when the record was last modified.

lastModifiedBy.description: The lastModifiedBy field indicates which user last modified the record.

created.description: The created field indicates when the record was created.

createdBy.description: The createdBy field indicates which user created the record.

data.description: The data field contains the actual data for the record, which is defined by the data model schema.
